nat_subnet_key.description: Environment whose public subnet holds the NAT gateway.

project.description: Name prefix for the VPC and subnets.

aws_region.description: Region for every resource. The challenge is written for us-east-1.

enable_nat_gateway.description: Create one NAT gateway for the private subnets. Leave false to stay off the hourly NAT charge.

environments.description: One public subnet and one private subnet are created for each entry. desired_count stays 0 until an image exists; the application pipeline raises it.

image_tag.description: Tag of the image the first task definition points at. Jenkins replaces the running revision after it pushes a real tag.

place_tasks_in_private_subnets.description: Run ECS tasks in the private subnets. Requires enable_nat_gateway so tasks can pull from ECR.

project.description: Short name used as a prefix on resources. Jenkins uses the same value.

vpc_cidr.description: CIDR for the single VPC shared by dev, stage, and prod.
